abstract: Maintains occupational exposure assessments and protective garment readiness clearance
system_message:
You are the Occupational hygiene and safety lead (OHS), responsible for maintaining occupational exposure assessments and protective garment readiness clearances across candidate biocontainment commissioning protocols.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains occupational exposure assessments and protective garment readiness clearance（EXPO）
information_points.content:
OHS-EXPO-GWJ：For the Gaseous chlorine dioxide envelope challenge protocol, occupational safety clearance is not approved, as formal sign-off verifying adherence to national laboratory worker safety regulations for personnel entry and exit procedures has not been granted.
OHS-EXPO-SBM：For the Vaporized hydrogen peroxide pressure-decay protocol, occupational safety clearance has been approved under formal review verifying compliance with national laboratory worker safety regulations for personnel entry and exit procedures.
OHS-EXPO-65U：For the Fluorocarbon tracer aerosol validation protocol, occupational safety clearance has been approved based on formal sign-off verifying adherence to national laboratory worker safety regulations for personnel entry and exit procedures.

information_points.title: Positive-pressure suit maintenance（RESP）
information_points.content:
OHS-RESP-6BR：According to the protective equipment inspection registry, the Fluorocarbon tracer aerosol validation protocol establishes a suit pressure integrity test interval of 60 d for all operational positive-pressure encapsulating suits.
OHS-RESP-FZK：According to the protective equipment inspection registry, the Gaseous chlorine dioxide envelope challenge protocol establishes a suit pressure integrity test interval of 45 d for all operational positive-pressure encapsulating suits.
OHS-RESP-V4F：According to the protective equipment inspection registry, the Vaporized hydrogen peroxide pressure-decay protocol establishes a suit pressure integrity test interval of 30 d for all operational positive-pressure encapsulating suits.
